doc.brief: The QAbstractSlider class provides an integer value within a range.

Qt::Orientation orientation() const.brief: This property holds the orientation of the slider

bool hasTracking() const.brief: This property holds whether slider tracking is enabled

bool invertedAppearance() const.brief: This property holds whether or not a slider shows its values inverted.

bool invertedControls() const.brief: This property holds whether or not the slider inverts its wheel and key events.

bool isSliderDown() const.brief: This property holds whether the slider is pressed down.

int maximum() const.brief: This property holds the slider's maximum value

int minimum() const.brief: This property holds the sliders's minimum value

int pageStep() const.brief: This property holds the page step.

int singleStep() const.brief: This property holds the single step.

int sliderPosition() const.brief: This property holds the current slider position

int value() const.brief: This property holds the slider's current value

void actionTriggered(int action).brief: This signal is emitted when the slider action *action* is triggered.

void rangeChanged(int min, int max).brief: This signal is emitted when the slider range has changed, with *min* being the new minimum, and *max* being the new maximum.

void setInvertedAppearance(bool).brief: This property holds whether or not a slider shows its values inverted.

void setInvertedControls(bool).brief: This property holds whether or not the slider inverts its wheel and key events.

void setMaximum(int).brief: This property holds the slider's maximum value

void setMinimum(int).brief: This property holds the sliders's minimum value

void setOrientation(Qt::Orientation).brief: This property holds the orientation of the slider

void setPageStep(int).brief: This property holds the page step.

void setRange(int min, int max).brief: Sets the slider's minimum to *min* and its maximum to *max*.

void setRepeatAction(QAbstractSlider::Sl.brief: Sets action *action* to be triggered repetitively in intervals of *repeatTime*, after an initial delay of *thresholdTime*.

void setSingleStep(int).brief: This property holds the single step.

void setSliderDown(bool).brief: This property holds whether the slider is pressed down.

void setSliderPosition(int).brief: This property holds the current slider position

void setTracking(bool enable).brief: This property holds whether slider tracking is enabled

void setValue(int).brief: This property holds the slider's current value

void sliderChange(QAbstractSlider::Slide.brief: Reimplement this virtual function to track slider changes such as [SliderRangeChange](xref:qt:QAbstractSlider), [SliderOrientationChange](xref:qt:QAbstractSlider)...

void sliderMoved(int value).brief: This signal is emitted when [sliderDown](xref:qt:QAbstractSlider) is true and the slider moves.

void sliderPressed().brief: This signal is emitted when the user presses the slider with the mouse, or programmatically when [setSliderDown](xref:qt:QAbstractSlider)(true) is called.

void sliderReleased().brief: This signal is emitted when the user releases the slider with the mouse, or programmatically when [setSliderDown](xref:qt:QAbstractSlider)(false) is called.

void valueChanged(int value).brief: This signal is emitted when the slider value has changed, with the new slider *value* as argument.
